author: JDeiTwo
body:
So, I was playing on a map as usual when suddenly my own teammate asked if I was hacking. I myself asked from him why he thought like that, but he didn't answer me. Soon after that I got banned for hacking. The banner was javipepe who I don't know, but I guess he is some kind of a moderator. When I try to connect to the Avicus server it says "Banned, you have been punished by javipepe for hacking is not allowed - spider on june 23, 2015 2:40:16 PM GMT.". Spider? I don't really know what "spider" means, but I quess its some type of a hack or something. I think you should unban me, because I didn't really do anything. At least I don't know what I did if I did something. I would really, really want to play on this server again, because I love it. :)

Br
TheWeecat.

PS. I am from Finland, 15 years old. My hacking capability is very low.

title: The new "unfairly banned from server" post

replies.author: Iron
replies.body:
Hello,

Based on evidence that I have obtained, it was clear that you were indeed using client-modifications. As seen here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kkuKhQZSQBQ You were clearly using Spider. You will not be apealed

Thanks,
Iron,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator
